measured_behaviour.providers_include_cpu_ep: INVALID_ARGUMENT on EVERY graph including fully-claimed ones - configuration conflict, ERROR(instrument), never a finding
measured_behaviour.providers_ep_only_declined_single_op: FAIL - fallback to CPU EP has been explicitly disabled

extents.no_cpu_fallback_precondition: graphs the EP must claim entirely: single-op tests, probes, negative controls. Fires at session creation, before any number exists.
extents.guard_d: any graph, including whole models with legitimate declines (Phi-3.5 declines ten edge ops when healthy). Fires after the run, from ORT profile.
extents.composition_note: two gates whose extents differ compose to the weaker extent and the stronger name; stated separately so neither borrows the other reach

red_text_migration.failure_text_on: _models.CpuFallbackRefused carrying ORT text: This session contains graph nodes that are assigned to the default CPU EP, but fallback to CPU EP has been explicitly disabled by the user
red_text_migration.reading: the count does not improve and was never expected to. The failing SET is identical on both devices, which is the falsifier that the precondition does not fire on a healthy single-op test. What moves is which instrument the reader is quoted (R13).

closes_row_reason: this is a mechanism, not a criterion tally. Supplying an artifact and closing a row must not be the same act.
